scope: Independent static Havenline invader concept review. No native mesh, rig, animation, or runtime approval.
observed_style_basis: Rounded chunky volumes and enlarged readable features; friendly character is compact and stylized.
Sculpted fur clumps and simplified layered winter clothing, leather straps, shearling trims and restrained metal.
Navy studio presentation, clean warm highlights, limited material noise and readable full silhouettes.
Existing friendly blues/orange are visual style references; hostile designs require distinct identity and allegiance cues.
mandatory_checks: Source-bounded three-type roster, no invented faction or tier counts
Same enemy identity, anatomy, clothing and fixed gear across turnaround and detail/use-state boards
Eight meaningful views including full rear and both opposite profiles, consistent scale and complete framing
No duplicated limbs, missing or floating fixed gear, material/anatomical clipping or unreadable key features
Hostile wolf is unharnessed and visibly distinct from companion wolf
Raider has a distinct hostile design rather than only recoloring the friendly survivor
Ice Brute reads as larger boss while retaining polished Havenline shape and material grammar
Detail/use-state board depicts the same approved design and actual useful closer views/states
Static-image limits explicit; no animation or native-asset certification inferred
